title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (pp. 722-724): Grothendieck is studying elliptic curves (2 invertible) through the Legendre picture. X/{±1} is a Brauer-Severi conic Y (a form of P^1_S) carrying the 3 nonzero 2-torsion branch points S' ⊂ Y, which is étale of degree 3 over S. Set U = Y \ S'. The previous page recalls two facts. First, the generalized Jacobian J^*_{U/S} is an extension of Z by the rank-2 torus J^0 = G_m ⊗ M(S'/S), where M = p_*Z_{S'}/Z_diag. Second, there is a unique Aut(S'/S)-equivariant 'Abel-Jacobi' morphism φ: U → J^0_{U/S} compatible with the universal property.

This page makes φ explicit in the split case S' = {0,1,∞}. Here J^0 = G_m^{{0,1,∞}}/G_m, and Ψ(z) = (-z, z-1, 1) is the class of the divisor z - (0,1,∞) with a sign normalization. The image is U_1, the trace on the torus of the line x_0+x_1+x_∞ = 0 in P^2. Ψ is an isomorphism U_{0,3} → U_1. It extends to P^1 ≅ the line in P^2, sending 0, 1, ∞ to the three coordinate points (0,1,-1), (-1,0,1), (1,-1,0) where the line meets the coordinate axes.

The signs are chosen so that Ψ is S_3-equivariant for the plain permutation action on coordinates:
- z ↦ 1-z swaps x_0 and x_1;
- z ↦ 1/z swaps x_0 and x_∞ up to scalar.
Hence the construction descends to any S_3-torseur, i.e. to twisted forms.

He then returns to the elliptic curve X/S, given by S → M'_{1,1}, to build (next page) a canonical map X → J^0_{U/S}. This interprets Legendre's λ-line together with its torus embedding in a form that is canonical and descends.
errors: No mathematical errors. Ψ(z) = (-z, z-1, 1) satisfies x_0+x_1+x_∞ = 0.
The two alternative normalizations (1, 1/z - 1, -1/z) and (-z/(z-1), 1, 1/(z-1)) are correct rescalings.

ideas.what: P^1 minus {0,1,∞} embedded via the generalized-Jacobian Abel-Jacobi map into the rank-2 torus G_m^3/G_m, with image the line x_0+x_1+x_∞ = 0 (S-unit equation form)
ideas.modern_name: Abel-Jacobi map to generalized Jacobian (Rosenlicht-Serre); M_{0,4} as a hyperplane-arrangement complement / unit equation
ideas.usually_credited_to: Rosenlicht, Serre (Groupes algébriques et corps de classes); classical

ideas.what: S_3-equivariant normalization of the Abel-Jacobi map, allowing descent to twisted forms (Y, S') attached to an S_3-torseur
ideas.modern_name: Galois twisting / descent of the λ-line and its torus embedding

ideas.what: Legendre theory: an elliptic curve with 2 invertible ↔ conic with 3 marked points (S_3-torseur) plus a section of the complement
ideas.modern_name: Legendre form / X(2) and the λ-line, twisted version
ideas.usually_credited_to: Legendre; Deligne-Rapoport / Katz-Mazur for moduli treatment

deep.surprise_reason: This is an explicit and correct routine computation: the S_3-equivariant Abel-Jacobi embedding of P^1 minus 3 points into the torus as the line x+y+z = 0. It serves a canonical-descent version of Legendre theory. Nothing here is new to specialists.
transcription_corrections: The label under the underbrace beneath G_m^{0,1,∞}/G_m appears to be the Jacobian (likely J or J^0 of U_{0,3}) rather than 'U'.
In (316) the ambient space is P^2_{S_0}; the subscript is a hastily written S_0.
